title: Launcher committed-input reader rejects valid engram source JSON when the owner emits its supported slow-operation stderr warning
outcome: The launcher's committed-input source reader accepts a valid `engram source --root --json` result whose stderr carries only Engram's supported, bounded slow-operation warning lines, while still refusing malformed, unexpected, error or oversized stderr and every existing stdout schema check.
acceptance: scripts/test-launcher-input.mjs no longer refuses a source observation solely because stderr contains Engram's supported slow-operation warning (the bounded warning grammar Engram documents for source observation / local git query, e.g. its 10 s warning); a node test with a stub owner that prints exactly that warning on stderr and a valid JSON envelope on stdout passes admission.

Any stderr that is not entirely the supported warning grammar (unknown text, an error line, a warning plus extra text, or stderr beyond a fixed byte bound) is still refused with ENGRAM_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE; node tests cover each of these refusal cases.
No retry, no blanket stderr suppression, and the existing malformed/non-UTF-8/oversized stdout and exact-field schema refusals are unchanged; the full launcher node suite stays green.
disposal_reason: Duplicate: the same launcher stderr defect (scripts/test-launcher-input.mjs:224-225 rejects any stderr from `engram source --json`) is already filed by Fable2 as w-e879e6155b1d, assigned to Sol-03d4 (ebe242f7 #7868). Engram::Fable #730 asked that the report be attached there instead. 11330's exact location and Engram's warning contract are noted on w-e879e6155b1d.
